  FROM session.fw_c453b4_m1_cdc
  WHERE countyfips = '01101' AND stateabbr = 'AL' AND casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
viol AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations_2026
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_c453b4' AND source = 'm2_city' AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  c.adult_asthma_rate_per_adult,
  c.adult_population,
  COALESCE(v.code_violations_2026, 0) AS code_violations_2026,
  t.geoid

WHERE c.adult_asthma_rate_per_adult IS NOT NULL

Selects Montgomery census tracts with adult asthma rates from CDC PLACES (filtered to countyfips 01101) and left-joins 2026 code violation counts per tract, ordering by asthma rate descending and including total adult population as denominator for rate transparency.
sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  CAST(c.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate_per_totalpop18plus,
  CAST(c.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
  COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS code_violations_2026,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN session.fw_c453b4_m1_cdc AS c
  ON c.tractfips = t.geoid
  AND c.countyfips = '01101'
  AND c.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS v
  ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  AND v.run_id = 'r_20261024_c453b4'
  AND v.source = 'm2_city'
  AND v.grp = 'all'
WHERE c.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate_per_totalpop18plus DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
